scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend/crud-generator && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend/crud-generator" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm start --prefix backend/crud-generator" "npm start --prefix frontend"
